authoring.author: claude-opus-5.5 (shopping-streets-5 lane), from strip-labelled.png
authoring.note: Van Baerlestraat 56-88 (even), from the PC Hooftstraat towards the Willemsparkweg corner: the 1890s shop houses (two black-painted stepped gables at 84 and 88, GANT, Pearle, Tempur, Premsela, Pauw three times), the 1920s fronts at 70 and 74-76, the 58-64 pand of a yellow Jugendstil house and a brick block, and the 1889 jack-block house at 56 with its white bands. The corner 52-54 (Small Talk) is held: its Van Baerlestraat footprint edge is a 2.4 m conservatory in front of the house the photo shows.
